t: What Memory Architecture Database Is All About
title: What Memory Architecture Database Is All About
description: Memory architecture is the hierarchy: registers (fastest, smallest), L1/L2/L3 cache (SRAM), DRAM (main memory: DDR4/DDR5, HBM for bandwidth), storage (NVMe SSD). Latency vs capacity vs cost at each level. ECC (error correction) for servers; the memory wall (CPU vs DRAM speed gap) drives design. Size the hierarchy to the workload. This database is the complete memory architecture: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
